verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Ashby's MCP server can search and retrieve 'referrals' as a recruiting record type. That implies referrals exist as data in Ashby, but nothing documents an employee-facing referral flow. missing for 10: an employee referral submission flow, employee-visible tracking of referral status and stage, any first-party docs describing the referral experience, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
